dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: Where should we go today? Want to dress up the Sumpter Beasts for the festivities together?

dialogues.speaker: Zai
dialogues.text: Woohoo! Is it a Sabzeruz tradition for people who keep Sumpter Beasts?

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: Eh? I, uh... I don't remember Dad ever doing it...

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: But don't you think it really adds to the festive mood?

dialogues.speaker: Nika
dialogues.text: The Dendro Archon will bless the trees with delicious apples, making the Sumpter Beasts happy too!

dialogues.speaker: Zai
dialogues.text: Oooh, that's right! If Sumpter Beasts are all dressed up and looking their best, and enjoy their food, they'll probably be tastier too!
